function.name: KB_search
function.description: Search the knowledge base for relevant documents.

query.description: The search query to find relevant documents

function.name: grep
function.description: Search for a regex pattern in all knowledge base documents. Returns documents ranked by number of matches, with full content.

pattern.description: The regex pattern to search for (e.g., 'refund.*order', 'fee|charge')

function.name: unlock_agent_discoverable_tool
function.description: Unlock an agent discoverable tool that was found in the knowledge base. Use this when the knowledge base indicates that you have access to a specialized internal tool. After unlocking, you can use the tool by calling `call_agent_discoverable_tool` with the tool name and required arguments.

tool_name.description: The exact tool name found in the knowledge base

function.name: unlock_user_discoverable_tool
function.description: Pass a tool to the user so they can execute it themselves. Use this when the knowledge base indicates that the user should perform an action themselves. This reveals the tool's interface; the user will then be able to call `call_user_discoverable_tool` with the tool name and the required arguments.

tool_name.description: The exact user tool name found in the knowledge base

function.name: call_agent_discoverable_tool
function.description: Call an agent discoverable tool that you have previously unlocked. Use this after unlocking a tool with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`. The knowledge base will tell you which tool to use and what arguments to provide.

tool_name.description: The name of the agent discoverable tool to call

arguments.description: JSON string of arguments for the tool (e.g., '{"user_id": "abc123"}')

function.name: call_user_discoverable_tool
function.description: Call a tool that was given to you by the agent. Use this when the agent has instructed you to perform an action using a discoverable tool. The agent will have told you the tool name and arguments.

tool_name.description: The name of the discoverable tool to call

arguments.description: JSON string of arguments for the tool (e.g., '{"order_id": "o1"}')

function.name: verify_customer_identity
function.description: Compare the caller's credentials with the enterprise profile and record verification. At least two supplied credentials must match exactly. The customer reference locates the profile and never counts as a credential. Supply only information the caller actually states, without rewriting it. A recorded successful verification is never downgraded by a later unsuccessful attempt. Identity verification must succeed before account business is transacted or money moved.

customer_id.description: Customer reference copied from the located enterprise profile; required.

phone.description: Caller-stated registered E.164 telephone number, verbatim; leave "" if unstated.

email.description: Caller-stated registered finance email address, verbatim; leave "" if unstated.

identity_document.description: Caller-stated eight-digit registered identity-document suffix, verbatim; leave "" if unstated.

opened_date.description: Caller-stated profile opening date in YYYY-MM-DD format, verbatim; leave "" if unstated.

function.name: transfer_to_human_agent
function.description: Record a referral to a human enterprise support specialist. Refer requests for which published policy provides no resolution, or a customer who explicitly asks for a human representative at least twice. The reason must use the corresponding controlled value; no descriptive explanation is stored.

customer_id.description: Customer reference copied from the located enterprise profile; required.

reason.description: Exactly POLICY_NOT_COVERED when policy cannot resolve the request, or CUSTOMER_REQUESTED when the customer has explicitly requested a human at least two times.

function.name: find_customers
function.description: Locate the enterprise customer profile by a known reference or exact contact information. The profile contains its legal company, authorized contact and registered verification credentials. This lookup does not verify identity. Supply any known criteria; matching profiles are returned, and an empty list means no match.

customer_id.description: Reference of the enterprise customer profile. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

company_name.description: Legal company name copied exactly from the customer. Use the exact caller-stated string; leave "" if not supplied.

contact_name.description: Authorized finance contact name copied exactly from the customer. Use the exact caller-stated string; leave "" if not supplied.

phone.description: Registered authorized contact telephone number. E.164 telephone string; leave "" if not supplied.

email.description: Registered finance contact email address copied exactly. Use the exact caller-stated string; leave "" if not supplied.

identity_document.description: Registered authorized contact identity-document suffix. Eight decimal digits; leave "" if not supplied.

opened_date.description: UTC date the customer profile was opened. YYYY-MM-DD; leave "" if not supplied.

function.name: find_verification_log
function.description: View the recorded identity-verification outcome for an enterprise contact using a customer or verification reference. Optional criteria select matching outcomes; an empty list means no recorded verification.

verification_id.description: Reference of the customer verification outcome. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

customer_id.description: Customer whose credentials were compared. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

function.name: find_handoff_log
function.description: Retrieve human-specialist referral records with their reason and creation time. Supply a customer or referral reference if known; an empty list means no matching referral.

handoff_id.description: Reference of the handoff. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

customer_id.description: Customer referred to a human specialist. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

function.name: find_compute_holdings
function.description: View the customer's Virtual Compute contracts, including the official tier, lifecycle state, approved commercial terms and billing entity. Any known contract or customer reference can select the matching records; omitted criteria impose no restriction and an empty list means no match.

compute_holding_id.description: Reference of the Virtual Compute contract. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

customer_id.description: Enterprise customer that owns this contract. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

request_id.description: Reference of the customer authorization recorded on this contract; copy from a retrieved record, or leave "" if unknown.

function.name: find_compute_events
function.description: Retrieve Virtual Compute consumption, invoice, adjustment, remittance and service evidence. Search by the contract or customer, an event reference, its original source, a customer request or related evidence. All criteria are optional; results preserve the recorded business details and an empty list means no match.

compute_event_id.description: Reference identifying this accounting or service event. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

compute_holding_id.description: Contract to which this event belongs. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

customer_id.description: Customer owning the event and the referenced contract. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

source_event_id.description: Narrowest original event corrected, billed, credited, paid or refunded; empty for an independent source. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

request_id.description: Customer request event reference; empty where no customer request is needed. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.

related_event_id.description: Additional linked approval, incident or evidence event; empty when absent. Copy the reference from a retrieved business record; leave "" if unknown.
